method: reconciled the Wave-2 8x1 screening contract across (a) session-level historical directives as relayed by committed qualification artifacts and operator memory, (b) the disposition scripts' coded behavior at audit commit a79bf406, (c) the persisted qualification artifacts. Original artifacts untouched.

clarifications.statement: 8x1 is a low-cost SCREENING (one fresh run per calibration case, single repeat). It is NOT B6 acceptance and produces no acceptance semantics.
clarifications.basis: all committed qualification artifacts name the stage 'screening_8x1' with disposition vocabulary READY_FOR_8X3 / NOT_QUALIFIED_SCREENING; 8x3 entry is gated on explicit user authorization (§22 of the relayed directive); B6 acceptance requires frozen holdouts and an AdmissionAudit (Gen-4 closure precedent).

clarifications.statement: Every scheduled run must be accounted — including abnormal failures. The accounting block reports scheduled_count, run_terminal_count, run_failed_count, run_integration_failed_count, snapshot_reproduced_count, failure_classified_count, unclassified_failure_count.
clarifications.basis: historical screening reports always reported scheduled_runs=8 with failed runs listed; RCA-1.5 makes the accounting explicit and machine-readable.

clarifications.statement: READY_FOR_8X3 is UNREACHABLE through any fallback branch. Exhaustiveness rule: an unclassified run-level failure forces REVIEW_REQUIRED; a classified run-level failure blocks READY with its class-specific reason. The only path to READY_FOR_8X3 is a series with zero run-level failures (all classified checks pass).
clarifications.basis: this clause is a CLARIFICATION ADOPTED UNDER THE RCA-1 DIRECTIVE (it was the audited defect, not a historical rule); it creates no new numeric threshold.

clarifications.statement: Failure classes are separated: MODEL_OUTPUT_RETRY_EXHAUSTED / MODEL_OUTPUT_VALIDATION_ERROR (model output), PROVIDER_RATE_LIMITED / PROVIDER_REQUEST_TIMEOUT / PROVIDER_CONNECTION_ERROR / PROVIDER_SERVER_ERROR (provider), SUPERVISOR_INTEGRATION_FAILED (runtime stage), BENCHMARK_RUNTIME_FAILURE (unclassified fallback). Provider classes never enter schema numerators (frozen §10 invariant).
clarifications.basis: wave-2 §18 taxonomy invariant + RCA-1.2 code changes (type-derived classification).

clarifications.statement: Question terminalization (charter q-1 leaving {open, in_progress}) is an INDEPENDENT reported metric. It is NOT automatically wired as a 100% screening gate in the disposition script. Run-level failure classes gate independently.
clarifications.basis: the coded contract never gated on terminalization; the relayed directive's frozen acceptance criteria mention q-1 terminalization as a qualification expectation. See CC-2.

clarifications.statement: The 0.5 collapse ceiling is split by axis with explicit denominators: RUN_AXIS = run-level output-retry failures / scheduled runs (screening stage); DELEGATION_AXIS = non-quota delegation failures / delegation attempts (B2-style measurement stage). Both remain 0.5; no value changed.
clarifications.basis: audit F-8: the constant had silently served two denominators across eras.

clarifications.statement: 2/2 snapshot reproduction is NEVER presentable as 8/8 evaluate-only completeness. snapshot_reproduced_count is reported against scheduled_count.

contract_review_required.ambiguity: The relayed historical directive phrase '8/8 通过' (8/8 pass) is not decidable from in-repo evidence: it may mean '8/8 runs reached terminal state' or '8/8 case successes (CaseOutcomeV2 success)'. The historical directive documents themselves are session-level and not committed to the repository.
contract_review_required.resolution_adopted_here: NONE. The reconciled machine contract does not need the reading: any run-level failure blocks READY regardless, so both readings agree that e.g. 2 terminal + 6 timeout is never READY. No new threshold was created.
contract_review_required.action: CONTRACT_REVIEW_REQUIRED — the operator should ratify the historical directive text into an in-repo frozen document.

contract_review_required.ambiguity: Whether READY_FOR_8X3 additionally requires 100% charter terminalization (SC-5 keeps it independent per the RCA-1.0 directive text; the relayed qualification criteria list q-1 terminalization among acceptance expectations).
contract_review_required.resolution_adopted_here: NONE — terminalization is reported as an independent metric; since any run-level failure already blocks READY, the practical difference is limited to all-terminal all-clean series with low terminalization (historically not observed).

disposition_vocabulary_unchanged: REVIEW_REQUIRED (added by the RCA-1 directive for unclassifiable failures)
